claims.text: The catalytic activity, selectivity, and durability of PGM-based nanoscale catalysts during ethanol oxidation are governed by a dynamic interplay among PGM oxidation state, surface composition, and reaction mechanisms.
Operando X-ray absorption spectroscopy and density functional theory calculations can elucidate this proposed dynamic interplay.
The relevant structural mediators are the oxidation state of the PGM atoms and the catalyst surface composition.
Applying operando XAS and DFT will enhance understanding of catalyst activity, selectivity, and durability.
The proposed hypothesis applies to PGM-based nanoscale catalysts under ethanol-oxidation conditions.
There is a lack of comprehensive mechanistic understanding of HEA catalysts in complex reactions such as ethanol oxidation.
Failure of operando XAS and DFT to reveal the proposed interplay would falsify the hypothesis.
